instructions.question: What overall sentiment does this Kosovo Facebook comment express toward the COVID-19 situation, the health institute, or the people involved?
instructions.rule: Positive means praise, thanks, good wishes, prayers for recovery, or joy at falling cases or rising recoveries. Negative means accusing the institute of lying, mocking it or its numbers, insulting the institute or the public, or expressing fear or despair. Neutral covers questions, requests (e.g. publish the list, reopen nurseries, impose masks), plain statistics, tagged names, and joking or sports-style banter about towns 'playing' or 'leading' that has no clear hostility. Sarcastic praise ('mashalla prizreni prin', 'situata nën kontroll') is negative.

neutral.what: Informational, questioning, or request-type comments, statistics posts, name tags, and light jokes or speculation with no clear praise or hostility, including policy opinions stated as suggestions.
examples: Mbani te paster telefonat gjithashtu [Keep phones clean too]
Luja Prizren luja [Play Prizren, play]
A bash qekaq jon smu a ? [Are that many really sick?]
Albert Haziri Ardit Haziri
neutral.cues: a (question particle), pse (why), qitne listen (publish the list), duhet (should), tagged names, raw statistics, karantin (quarantine) requests
neutral.not_for: Questions that accuse lying or incompetence (negative); requests that include thanks (positive).

positive.what: Gratitude, praise for health workers or the institute, congratulations to the recovered, blessings and prayers, optimism about improving numbers, cheerful encouragement.
examples: Urime të Sheruarve! [Congratulations to the recovered!]
Allahu i sheroft [May God heal them]
Ju lumtë për punën... [Well done for your work...]
U arrit 5000, tash bjen numri i infektuarve! [5000 reached, now the infected number will fall!]
positive.cues: urime (congratulations), ju lumt (well done), respekt (respect), hallall (well deserved), ishallah/inshallah (God willing), zoti ju ndihmoft (God help you), sherim te shpejt (quick recovery), bravo, mashalla (sincere)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic 'mashalla'/'bravo' aimed at bad numbers or behaviour (negative); polite suggestions without any praise (neutral).

negative.what: Distrust, accusations of lies or manipulated numbers, insults to the institute, government or public, angry complaints, mockery of the figures, despair or alarm about worsening spread.
examples: Rrenaa.mashtrime politike [Lies, political deceptions]
Ska virus #meLabin [There is no virus]
Prishtina po eskalon [Pristina is escalating]
Situata nën Kontroll o minister ZEZA [Situation under control, minister — DISASTER]
negative.cues: rrena/rreni (lies), mashtrim (deceit), spo ju besoj (I don't believe you), hajgare (joke/farce), injorant, budall (fool), tmer (horror), ska virus (no virus), sarcastic mashalla
negative.not_for: Mild worry or neutral warnings to wear masks without hostility (neutral); joking about towns' rankings without contempt (neutral).
